bull_case: Adobe is retiring stock well below locked Base value while funding AI adaptation and a modest Semrush acquisition from internal cash generation.
bear_case: Buybacks can destroy value if the moat is structurally breaking, and Semrush has too little post-close history to demonstrate realized ROIC.
thesis: Capital allocation is favorable but not yet exceptional. Using the disclosed monthly Q4 FY2025, Q1–Q2 FY2026 repurchase prices plus Q3 repurchase cash/shares, the latest four-quarter average repurchase price is estimated at ~$279.24, only 0.563x the locked Base value $495.57; the observable rubric maps this to 80. Semrush cost $1.87B and contributed ~$480M ARR at Q2, but standalone FCF/ROIC are not disclosed.

evidence.claim: Estimated latest-four-quarter average repurchase price is ~$279.24/share across ~33.3M shares, using disclosed Q4 FY2025 and Q1–Q2 FY2026 monthly prices plus Q3 repurchase cash/shares.
Estimated four-quarter repurchase price / locked Base value is ~0.563x ($279.24 / $495.57).
Semrush acquisition closed for $1.87B primarily cash; Q2 Total Adobe ARR included about $480M from Semrush.
Q3 AI-first ending ARR exceeded $650M and Adobe raised FY2026 revenue/EPS targets while transitioning CEO duties to Anil Chakravarthy effective Dec. 1, 2026.

counterevidence: Semrush standalone FCF, retention, synergy realization and realized ROIC are not disclosed.
Q3 average repurchase price is estimated from repurchase cash flow divided by reported shares and may differ from exact execution price.
CEO transition adds execution uncertainty during a period of structural AI competition.
unknowns: Realized ROIC/IRR and standalone economics of Semrush.
Exact Q3 repurchase execution price and future acquisition discipline under the incoming CEO.
falsifiers: Repurchases continue above intrinsic value while per-share FCF deteriorates.
Semrush fails to sustain ARR/FCF contribution commensurate with purchase price.
AI commercialization stalls through the CEO transition.

subscores.rationale: Observable metric: estimated latest-four-quarter average repurchase price ~$279.24 / locked Base $495.57 = ~0.563x, inside the <0.8 band, so score 80. No +10 exit/reallocation modifier is applied.
75 good-governance anchor: no restatement, auditor disagreement or integrity impairment is established; evidence does not justify 90 very-high-trust treatment.
Above 75 because AI-first ARR, MAU and revenue targets show concrete adaptation; below 90 because the structural AI response and CEO transition have not been proven across a full cycle.

uncertainties.rationale: Repurchase valuation is strongly favorable mechanically; Semrush realized return remains unverified.
No cutoff-valid integrity impairment is established; ordinary governance risk remains.
AI commercialization is progressing, but leadership transition and competitive durability remain unproven.
